_note: SessionStart hook: injects a tiny luamemo digest into session context so the agent knows what persistent memory + codebase map exist without being asked. memo reads the settings itself (the project's .luamemorc, found from the project directory up, over ~/.luamemorc) — the hook only starts it there, and wraps its output as hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext (plain stdout is NOT reliably injected). memo is run through bash: a git checkout of the plugin may not keep its executable bit. memo brief is hard-capped by timeout and fail-soft, so the hook never blocks or errors the session.

hooks.command: sh -c 'cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" 2>/dev/null; d=$(bash "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/cli/memo" brief 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$d" ] && printf "%s" "$d" | jq -Rs "{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:\"SessionStart\",additionalContext:.}}" || true'
